meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, Toutiao, or Tencent Cloud Developer Community drafts through a browser. Use for product introductions, encyclopedia articles or entry drafts, and writing tailored to platforms or search targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文章转成公众号排版,并生成各平台草稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常写文章还要手动排版发到公众号、知乎等平台
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown articles into WeChat-ready layouts and platform drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write articles and publish them to WeChat, Zhihu and more

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令行,把 Markdown 转成微信公众号 HTML:先做元数据检查和预览,再按需生成封面或信息图、创建草稿;还能给标题候选、按创作者风格写作、去除 AI 写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML、生成文章配图或草稿,或提到知乎、CSDN 等平台的未发布草稿时触发,写作类需求同样走此技能。

say.text: 把 article.md 转成公众号 HTML,先给我预览
say.note: 先 inspect 再 preview,不上传不建草稿

say.text: 给 article.md 出几个微信标题候选
say.note: 只发出标题提示请求,不选也不写最终标题

say.text: 帮我把这篇文章的 AI 写作痕迹去掉

howto.what_en: Claude drives the md2wechat CLI to turn Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML: metadata checks, preview, then on request covers, infographics, and drafts. It also suggests titles, writes in creator styles, and removes AI traces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to convert Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML, generate article images or drafts, or handle unpublished drafts for Zhihu, CSDN, and similar platforms.

say_en.text: Convert article.md to WeChat HTML and preview it first
say_en.note: Runs inspect then preview; no upload or draft

say_en.text: Suggest WeChat title candidates for article.md
say_en.note: Emits a title prompt request only

say_en.text: Remove the AI writing traces from this article
